items.t: In Cypress Park Estates, West Vancouver, houses sold at a median of $2,578,000 across 15 sales, and the middle half closed between $2,395,000 and $3,307,500. The median house sat 31 days and sold for 93.6% of list.

Cypress Park Estates, West Vancouver: 11 condos sold at a median of $1,745,000, with the middle half between $1,446,500 and $2,090,000. The median condo took 28 days to sell and closed at 94.6% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Cypress Park Estates compares with the rest of West Vancouver

items.t: Of 18 West Vancouver sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Cypress Park Estates ranks 11th highest at $2,578,000; the range is $1,975,000 (Glenmore) to $5,950,000 (Altamont). Ambleside ($2,520,000) sits just below and Caulfeild ($2,678,000) sits just above.
Condos in Cypress Park Estates have the highest median of the 6 West Vancouver sub-areas, $1,745,000, ahead of Dundarave at $1,186,500; the lowest is Cedardale at $581,900.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Cypress Park Estates, West Vancouver (median 2005) and houses the oldest (median 1988), a gap of 17 years.
